archive.description: corresponds to the state of the archive as of 2020-09-30, which contains ThermoML entries published through the 2019 calendar year. The date of the extraction from TRC databases, as specified in the dateCit field of the xml files, are 2020-09-29 and 2020-09-30.  The .tgz file contains a directory tree that maps to the DOI prefix/suffix of the entries; e.g. unzipping the .tgz file creates a directory for each of the prefixes ( 10.1007, 10.1016, and 10.1021) that contains all the .json and .xml files.
